Name: Session Status for Claude Code
Author: Jacopo Gargano
Description: One key per Claude Code session, in iTerm2, Terminal, Ghostty, Warp, WezTerm, kitty or VS Code, coloured by what it needs from you: a question, a permission prompt, finished work to check, or still working. Press a key to jump to that session.

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the Nth Claude Code session and its state. Press to jump to it.
